visual_connections.description: On-premises database sends sales invoice data over the VPN connection.
VPN routes incoming traffic to AWS DMS.
DMS replicates sales data into Redshift.
File arrivals in S3 bucket kick off messages to SQS.
SQS messages launch the initiator Lambda function.
Initiator Lambda queries DynamoDB to pull metadata about incoming files.
Initiator Lambda pushes file contents into the Data Lake buckets.
Data Lake event trigger launches the complex processing Lambda function.
Processing Lambda writes merged/refined demand files back into the Data Lake.
Processing Lambda loads processed demand data into Redshift.
Data Lake reads and queries back into Redshift.
